title: LTFRB, OSG: Loophole in the law allows foreign firm to operate taxi fleet

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A loophole in the law apparently allowed a Vietnamese firm to fully operate a taxi fleet using electric vehicles (EVs) in the country despite the 1987 Constitution limiting foreign ownership to 40 percent in specific sectors, according to the Land Transportation Franchising and Regulatory Board (LTFRB) and the Office of the Solicitor General (OSG). During the House of Representatives committee on transportation hearing on Wednesday, several lawmakers questioned why the foreign firm was allowed to operate locally, raising concerns whether it was still in accordance with the Costitution, which reserves at least 60 percent ownership for Filipino citizens […]...
